query: Donald Trump attendance LIV Golf Bedminster events history as president 2025 2026, does Trump attend LIV Golf tournaments at his clubs
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's a summary of the key findings on Donald Trump's LIV Golf attendance:

## Bottom Line

**Trump attends LIV Golf events at his clubs with near-total consistency** — he has shown up in person at essentially every LIV tournament held at a Trump property since 2022, both as a private citizen and as sitting president.

### Bedminster history (3 events total)
- **2022** (July 29–31) — inaugural event, attended
- **2023** (Aug 11–13) — attended
- **2026** (Aug 6–9) — upcoming; the **first Bedminster LIV event of his second presidency**
- **No Bedminster events in 2024 or 2025** (there's a gap between 2023 and 2026)

### Second-term (2025–2026) LIV attendance at his other clubs
- **LIV Miami/Doral** (April 4–6, 2025) — attended as president with Eric Trump and Gov. DeSantis
- **LIV Virginia/Trump National DC** (May 9, 2026) — watched from a presidential suite with Eric Trump and a PIF representative

### Key uncertainty
LIV Golf's future is shaky: Saudi's PIF confirmed it will **end funding at the close of the 2026 season**, chairman Al-Rumayyan is expected to step down, and there were April 2026 shutdown rumors and layoff warnings. However, LIV's CEO insists the **full 2026 season (including Bedminster) will be completed**, and as of mid-July 2026 the Aug 6–9 Bedminster event remains on the official schedule with tickets on sale.

The structured findings (key facts, sources, and quantitative data points) have been submitted.
